issues.problem: $68.6B was Amazon's FY2024 operating income. As best I recall, FY2025 operating income was about $80B. The $77.7B net income is higher partly because of non-operating gains from the Anthropic investment.

data.summary: Revenue, the growth rate and net income look correct. The operating income figure appears to be the FY2024 number used in place of FY2025 (about $80B). I couldn't confirm total assets and cash from memory.
